amount.desc: Raw transaction amount in the transaction's currency.
amount.fraud_signal: Unusually high amounts vs the user's historical average are a strong signal.

amount_log.desc: log1p(amount). Compresses the heavy-tailed distribution for the model.
amount_log.fraud_signal: Works alongside 'amount' to capture both small probe txs and large spikes.

amount_ratio.desc: amount / user's average_transaction_amount. Values >> 1 mean the tx is far above normal.
amount_ratio.fraud_signal: > 5× the user's average is flagged as is_large_spike.

amount_vs_balance.desc: amount / user's account balance. High ratio means the tx nearly drains the account.
amount_vs_balance.fraud_signal: Account-draining transfers are a classic takeover pattern.

is_tiny_probe.desc: 1 if amount < 2.0 (ANY currency). Fraudsters send micro-txs to verify account is live.
is_tiny_probe.fraud_signal: A tiny probe followed by a large tx on the same account is a red flag.

is_large_spike.desc: 1 if amount_ratio > 5. The current transaction is 5× the user's normal spend.
is_large_spike.fraud_signal: High-value outlier relative to the user's own history.

tx_hour.desc: Hour of day (local server time) when the transaction was created.
tx_hour.fraud_signal: Fraud clusters in night hours (23:00–05:00); captured by is_night.

tx_dow.desc: Day of week of the transaction.
tx_dow.fraud_signal: Weekend transactions have slightly higher fraud rates in this dataset.

is_night.desc: 1 if tx_hour is between 23:00 and 05:59 inclusive.
is_night.fraud_signal: Most users don't transfer money at 3 AM.

is_weekend.desc: 1 if the transaction falls on Saturday or Sunday.
is_weekend.fraud_signal: Support staff are reduced on weekends, fraudsters exploit this.

user_age_days.desc: Days between the user account creation date and the transaction date.
user_age_days.fraud_signal: New accounts (< 30 days) committing large transfers are high risk.

recipient_is_new.desc: 1 if this is the first time this user has sent money to this recipient.
recipient_is_new.fraud_signal: The #1 ranked feature. Fraudsters always transfer to new/unknown accounts.

beneficiary_tx_count.desc: How many prior transactions this user has sent to the same to_account (cumulative count up to this transaction, sorted by created_at). 0 = brand new beneficiary.
beneficiary_tx_count.fraud_signal: The lower this is, the more novel the recipient.

trust_score.desc: Platform-computed trust score for the user (stored in User.trust_score). Updated by TrustScoreHistory events. 100 = fully trusted.
trust_score.fraud_signal: Compromised accounts tend to have erratic or declining trust scores.

average_transaction_amount.desc: The user's long-run average transaction amount, stored on the User record.
average_transaction_amount.fraud_signal: Used as the denominator in amount_ratio.

balance.desc: Current account balance at time of feature engineering.

user_tx_count_24h.desc: Approximate cumulative transaction count for this user (expanding window sorted by timestamp, not a strict 24h rolling window). Replace with a true rolling window when connected to a live DB.
user_tx_count_24h.fraud_signal: Burst of transactions in a short window = account takeover pattern.

login_failed_attempts_total.desc: Sum of all LoginEvent.failed_attempts for this user across all login events.
login_failed_attempts_total.fraud_signal: High failed attempt total suggests brute-force credential attack.

login_vpn_count.desc: Number of LoginEvents where LoginEvent.is_vpn = True for this user.
login_vpn_count.fraud_signal: VPN usage can mask geographic origin of attacker.

login_proxy_count.desc: Number of LoginEvents where LoginEvent.is_proxy = True for this user.
login_proxy_count.fraud_signal: Proxy usage is a stronger anonymisation signal than VPN.

login_risk_score_mean.desc: Mean of LoginEvent.risk_score across all login events for this user.
login_risk_score_mean.fraud_signal: Persistently high login risk scores precede fraudulent transactions.

login_success_rate.desc: Fraction of LoginEvents where LoginEvent.success = True.
login_success_rate.fraud_signal: A low success rate means many failed logins — credential stuffing.

login_country_nunique.desc: Number of distinct countries seen in LoginEvent.country for this user.
login_country_nunique.fraud_signal: Logging in from many countries is impossible-travel behaviour.

device_count.desc: Total number of Device records associated with this user.
device_count.fraud_signal: Sudden spike in device count = attacker registering new devices.

trusted_device_count.desc: Number of devices where Device.is_trusted = True for this user.
trusted_device_count.fraud_signal: Low trusted count means most activity is from unrecognised devices.

os_nunique.desc: Number of distinct Device.os values seen for this user.
os_nunique.fraud_signal: A single user logging in from Windows, Android, Linux, iOS simultaneously is suspicious.

browser_nunique.desc: Number of distinct Device.browser values seen for this user.
browser_nunique.fraud_signal: Similar to os_nunique — excessive browser diversity is unusual.

untrusted_device_ratio.fraud_signal: 1.0 means ALL devices are untrusted — very high risk.

session_country_mismatch.desc: 1 if the country of the user's most recent Session differs from User.home_country. Proxies 'is the user transacting from abroad?'
session_country_mismatch.fraud_signal: Impossible travel or account takeover from a foreign country.

seclog_count.desc: Total SecurityLog events for this user.
seclog_count.fraud_signal: Many security events mean the account has already triggered alerts.

seclog_risk_mean.desc: Mean SecurityLog.risk_score across all security log entries for this user.
seclog_risk_mean.fraud_signal: Persistently elevated security risk precedes fraud.

seclog_critical_count.desc: Number of SecurityLog entries with severity = 'CRITICAL' for this user.
seclog_critical_count.fraud_signal: Critical alerts are rare and highly predictive of fraud.

seclog_high_count.desc: Number of SecurityLog entries with severity = 'HIGH' for this user.
seclog_high_count.fraud_signal: Second tier alert severity; combined with CRITICAL gives full picture.

trust_delta_mean.desc: Net change in trust score: last TrustScoreHistory.new_score minus first TrustScoreHistory.new_score for this user. Negative = declining trust.
trust_delta_mean.fraud_signal: A sharply declining trust score indicates recent bad behaviour.

trust_change_count.desc: Number of TrustScoreHistory records for this user.
trust_change_count.fraud_signal: Many changes = volatile trust history, often tied to fraud events.

status_blocked.fraud_signal: The rule engine already flagged this transaction.

status_held.fraud_signal: On hold for manual review — moderate risk signal.

status_2fa.fraud_signal: System requested a second factor — moderate risk signal.

currency_foreign.desc: 1 if Transaction.currency != 'ALL' (Albanian Lek). Foreign currency transaction.
currency_foreign.fraud_signal: Cross-currency transfers are used to obscure money movement.

home_country_enc.desc: Label-encoded User.home_country (sklearn LabelEncoder, fit on training data).
home_country_enc.fraud_signal: Indirect; model learns country-level fraud rates.

session_country_enc.desc: Label-encoded country of the user's most recent Session.
session_country_enc.fraud_signal: Certain session origin countries have higher fraud rates.

role_enc.desc: Label-encoded User.role (CUSTOMER=0, ANALYST=1, ADMIN=2 — order may vary).
role_enc.fraud_signal: Admin/analyst roles transacting large amounts is anomalous.
